Container.Name: botdarr
Container.Overview: A chat bot that lets you search, add, and monitor Radarr, Sonarr, and Lidarr content from Discord, Telegram, Slack, Matrix, or Mattermost. Configure exactly ONE chat client section below, plus whichever media servers you run. The single appdata path holds the generated config, the sqlite database, and logs. Note: settings filled in here update the config/properties file on every container start, so editing this form and pressing Apply is all that is needed; properties added by hand to that file are preserved.
Container.Requires: Exactly one chat client (Mattermost, Discord, Telegram, Slack, or Matrix) must be configured, otherwise the bot refuses to start. Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr sections are each optional but all fields in a section are required to enable it.

Config.Name: appdata
Config.Description: Path where the bot stores its config, sqlite database, and logs (settings above update config/properties on every container start; manual entries are preserved)

Config.Name: mattermost_url
Config.Description: Mattermost: the url of your mattermost instance (one chat client only)

Config.Name: mattermost_token
Config.Description: Mattermost: the bot account's personal access token (don't share)

Config.Name: mattermost_channels
Config.Description: Mattermost: comma delimited list of channel ids the bot listens and posts in; the bot must be a member of each channel

Config.Name: discord_token
Config.Description: Discord: the bot token (don't share) (one chat client only)

Config.Name: discord_channels
Config.Description: Discord: comma delimited list of channel names the bot has access to

Config.Name: telegram_token
Config.Description: Telegram: the bot token from BotFather (don't share) (one chat client only)

Config.Name: telegram_private_channels
Config.Description: Telegram: comma delimited list of CHANNEL_NAME:CHANNEL_ID pairs for private channels

Config.Name: telegram_private_groups
Config.Description: Telegram: comma delimited list of GROUP_NAME:GROUP_ID pairs for private groups

Config.Name: slack_bot_token
Config.Description: Slack: the bot oauth authentication token (don't share) (one chat client only)

Config.Name: slack_app_token
Config.Description: Slack: the app authentication token (required for socket mode)

Config.Name: slack_channels
Config.Description: Slack: comma delimited list of channels to post messages to

Config.Name: matrix_username
Config.Description: Matrix: the bot username (one chat client only)

Config.Name: matrix_password
Config.Description: Matrix: the bot password (don't share)

Config.Name: matrix_room
Config.Description: Matrix: comma delimited list of rooms to send/receive messages from

Config.Name: matrix_home_server_url
Config.Description: Matrix: the url of your matrix homeserver

Config.Name: radarr_url
Config.Description: Radarr: the url of your radarr instance - defaults to a container named radarr on the same docker network (all four radarr fields required to enable movies)

Config.Name: radarr_token
Config.Description: Radarr: api key from Radarr -> Settings -> General (don't share)

Config.Name: radarr_default_profile
Config.Description: Radarr: quality profile name (must already exist in radarr - 'Any' is radarr's default profile)

Config.Name: radarr_path
Config.Description: Radarr: root folder where added movies should go

Config.Name: radarr_url_base
Config.Description: Radarr: only set if radarr runs under a custom url base (no prefix/suffix slashes)

Config.Name: radarr_default_availability
Config.Description: Radarr: minimum availability for added movies (see servarr wiki)

Config.Name: sonarr_url
Config.Description: Sonarr: the url of your sonarr instance - defaults to a container named sonarr on the same docker network (all four sonarr fields required to enable shows)

Config.Name: sonarr_token
Config.Description: Sonarr: api key from Sonarr -> Settings -> General (don't share)

Config.Name: sonarr_default_profile
Config.Description: Sonarr: quality profile name (must already exist in sonarr - 'Any' is sonarr's default profile)

Config.Name: sonarr_path
Config.Description: Sonarr: root folder where added shows should go

Config.Name: sonarr_url_base
Config.Description: Sonarr: only set if sonarr runs under a custom url base (no prefix/suffix slashes)

Config.Name: sonarr_v4
Config.Description: Sonarr: true if you are running Sonarr v4

Config.Name: lidarr_url
Config.Description: Lidarr: the url of your lidarr instance - defaults to a container named lidarr on the same docker network (all five lidarr fields required to enable artists)

Config.Name: lidarr_token
Config.Description: Lidarr: api key from Lidarr -> Settings -> General (don't share)

Config.Name: lidarr_default_quality_profile
Config.Description: Lidarr: quality profile name (must already exist in lidarr - 'Any' is lidarr's default profile)

Config.Name: lidarr_default_metadata_profile
Config.Description: Lidarr: metadata profile name (must already exist in lidarr - 'Any' is lidarr's default metadata profile)

Config.Name: lidarr_path
Config.Description: Lidarr: root folder where added artists/music should go

Config.Name: lidarr_url_base
Config.Description: Lidarr: only set if lidarr runs under a custom url base (no prefix/suffix slashes)

Config.Name: command_prefix
Config.Description: The command prefix used in chat (default !)

Config.Name: max_requests_threshold
Config.Description: Threshold type for request limits: WEEK, MONTH, or DAY

Config.Name: max_movie_requests_per_user
Config.Description: Max movie requests per user per threshold period

Config.Name: max_show_requests_per_user
Config.Description: Max show requests per user per threshold period

Config.Name: max_artist_requests_per_user
Config.Description: Max artist requests per user per threshold period

Config.Name: max_results_to_show
Config.Description: Max search results to show per command (<= 0 disables downloads display)

Config.Name: max_downloads_to_show
Config.Description: Max current downloads to show in notifications (0 or less hides them)

Config.Name: notification_interval
Config.Description: Minutes between download status notifications

Config.Name: existing_item_paths_blacklist
Config.Description: Comma delimited paths to exclude from library searches

Config.Name: status_endpoints
Config.Description: Extra endpoints for the !status command (comma delimited)

Config.Name: timeout
Config.Description: Connection/read timeout in milliseconds for all outbound requests

Config.Name: log_level
Config.Description: log4j log level (trace, debug, info, warn, error)
